fields.display_value: Real-Time Medication Temperature Monitoring and Alerting (LogTag Online)
fields.label: Demand

fields.display_value: Implement LogTag Online with Wi-Fi-enabled data loggers at select AHMG Urology clinics to provide real-time notification when medication storage temperatures move outside established parameters. The solution will supplement existing temperature-monitoring processes by enabling clinic leaders to respond promptly to power outages or temperature excursions.
fields.label: Description

fields.display_value:
Provide timely visibility into medication storage conditions so clinic teams can intervene before temperature excursions result in medication loss.

Protect high-value medication inventory: Reduce the risk of losing costly medications because of undetected power outages or temperature excursions.
Enable timely intervention: Provide real-time alerts so responsible clinic personnel can move medication to appropriate alternate storage when necessary.
Support a scalable monitoring approach: Establish an approved solution for the initial Urology locations that can be considered for additional clinics with similar monitoring and alerting needs.

qa.string_answer: LogTag Online does not require vendor-provided end user computing devices such as desktops, laptops, or terminals. The solution is accessed via any modern web browser on customer-owned devices, or optionally through the LogTag Mobile App on iOS or Android devices owned by the end user. The solution does however require LogTag data loggers — hardware sensing instruments supplied by LogTag North America Inc. and distributed by MicroDAQ — which collect and transmit environmental data to the LogTag Online cloud platform. These are data acquisition instruments rather than end user computing devices.

The primary access method is via standard web browser at logtagonline.com, which can operate within a customer's existing enterprise security and authentication infrastructure. The underlying platform leverages Microsoft Azure security architecture and complies with ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 1/2/3, FedRAMP, and FDA 21 CFR Part 11, among other frameworks. No planned timeline for enterprise authentication integration is documented in available product materials. LogTag Online does not currently support the listed standard data interface protocols. LogTag Online is an environmental monitoring and compliance platform rather than a clinical data system, and as such does not natively integrate with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7, FHIR, DICOM, or Cerner Millennium.

Data exchange within the platform is handled through the following methods:

CSV export of logger temperature/humidity data and event logs
PDF report generation for compliance documentation and inspection logs
LTD file format (proprietary LogTag format) downloadable for use in LogTag Analyzer software
Email and SMS/WhatsApp notifications for alarm and event alerts
Cloud-based data storage accessible via web browser or mobile app

For any deeper integration requirements, MicroDAQ recommends contacting LogTag North America Inc. directly to discuss available API options or custom integration possibilities that may not be reflected in current public documentation.
